change.summary: Operators and downstream operators may not place or make available relevant commodities or products on the EU market unless they are deforestation-free, produced in accordance with the producing country's legislation, and covered by a due diligence statement or simplified declaration. This applies to all operators and downstream operators placing relevant commodities or products on the market.

obligations.text: Do not place relevant commodities on the market unless they have been produced in accordance with the relevant legislation of the country of production.
obligations.quote: they have been produced in accordance with the relevant legislation of the country of production;

obligations.text: Do not place relevant commodities on the market unless they are covered by a due diligence statement or a simplified declaration.
obligations.quote: they are covered by a due diligence statement or a simplified declaration, as required by the relevant provisions of this Regulation.

reasons: You sell wooden furniture and leather goods, which fall under the regulation's wood and cattle commodity categories.
Your shop is based in Germany and ships to multiple EU countries, so you are placing these products on the EU market.
The regulation requires you to verify legal production and submit a due diligence statement for each product.

todos.text: Ask your suppliers for proof that wood and leather were produced legally in their country of origin
todos.quote: they have been produced in accordance with the relevant legislation of the country of production;

todos.text: Set up a due diligence system to collect geolocation data and risk assessments for wood and leather products, and prepare a due diligence statement or simplified declaration
todos.quote: they are covered by a due diligence statement or a simplified declaration, as required by the relevant provisions of this Regulation.
